notes.subject: go rot bilong bel no stret
notes.rationale: תרעלה em i tok bilong man i wokabaut go rot, olsem man i dring wain tumas — KJV 'astonishment', narapela 'staggering'.

notes.subject: הראיתה עמך קשה
notes.rationale: Sampela tanim: 'yu mekim ol man bilong yu lukim samting hat'; narapela: 'yu givim ol man bilong yu samting hat'.

translation: Yu olsem lukim ol man bilong yu samting hat, yu givim mipela dringim wain bilong go rot bilong bel no stret.

tokens.gloss: bilong go rot bilong bel no stret
